issues.title: Name the bad line when a stock file is malformed
issues.body:
A malformed stock file stops `inventory` with a Python traceback, and the message does not say which line is wrong. In a file of 200 lines, nobody can find the bad one.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `items.load` raises `items.StockFileError` for a malformed line. `StockFileError` is a subclass of `ValueError`, and has the attributes `path` and `line` (the line number, counted from 1).
- [ ] For a stock file whose line 3 has three fields, every command prints `<path>:3: expected 4 fields, got 3` to stderr and exits with status 2, with no traceback. `<path>` is the path as given on the command line.
- [ ] A quantity or a price that is not a number is a malformed line too, with the same `<path>:<line>: <message>` form.
- [ ] `parse_line` still raises `ValueError` for a malformed line.
